subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be narrowed to docs/help for the current Shift+Enter behavior, or should OpenClaw add a public TUI keybinding configuration bridge for Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter preferences?
rationale: The default multiline behavior is already supplied by pi-tui, while adding configurable send/newline keybindings would create a new compatibility-sensitive config or CLI surface that needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Document Current Behavior First
options.body: Add TUI docs and /help guidance for Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings until explicitly approved.

options.title: Approve Configurable Keybindings
options.body: Add an OpenClaw-owned config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with migration/docs/tests for default Enter-to-send compatibility.

options.title: Close As Implemented
options.body: Treat dependency-backed Shift+Enter support as satisfying the central request and leave configurable send-key preferences to a new narrower issue.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior First
recommendation.body: Add TUI docs and /help guidance for Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings until explicitly approved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current routing signal for TUI editor ownership and already mapped this issue's remaining product scope.
